description: Free. Neutral aggregation of published Bundestag Sonntagsfrage polls from DAWUM, per party (AfD, CDU/CSU, SPD, Grüne, FDP, Linke, BSW): range, simple mean and number of institutes over the last 7 days, shift in percentage points against the 7 days before (null when a window has fewer than 2 values), and the polls used with institute and date. Not a forecast, not a recommendation, not a call to vote.
name: get_party_polls
title: Parteien-Radar: Bundestag polls per party (7-day range, mean, shift)
